neighbours.label: the Chinese comma after a terse slogan-style phrase (投资房产，发展经济，), as opposed to the comma after an ordinary clause in the same topics, with a subject or without one
quiet: 我们每天都在节约用水，因为水很贵。
他从小就很节约，从来不乱花钱。
我打算明年开始理财，现在还没准备好。
那家店的老板很诚信，顾客都喜欢他。
医生让我按时服药，我一直没有忘记。

notes: Card: '，' x27 of the top 32. Probes: 投资房产， 0.55, 买房投资， 0.82, 读书学习， 0.47, 发展经济， 0.35, 身体健康， 0.33, 工作认真， 0.24; 如果你愿意， 0.04, 天气这么冷， 0.04, 我喜欢喝茶， 0.02, 吃得太多， 0.14, 、 0.01. Semicolons in football line-ups (0.19-0.27) are on the card and not covered. The declared token is every Chinese comma, so coverage is an upper bound. Most near misses are longer than the fire items; the three short ones (睡得太晚，, 她睡得早，, 吃得太咸，) control for length, and two of those have no subject.
